body: server/guild/guild.go: Registry, Guild, Item (KindFeather/KindFeatherSack), Membership (Member/Officer/Leader). CreateGuild gives founder a Feather Sack. ForgeFeather (Officer+ issues member tokens). ForgeFeatherSack (Leader-only promotes to Officer). RevokeItem (removes from roster, marks revoked). CanChat() gates guild chat on active item. 22 tests: item lifecycle, role gating, revocation, cross-scene chat auth.
title: S79-01: DragonsNShit linkshell guild system — Feather/Feather Sack, 22 tests
